summary:
The hand-written sections now describe revision r6: 55 decisions, 55 settled, 0 open. The strict build has no warning, `check.mjs` ends with "All checks passed.", and a new browser profile shows "55 / 55 answered" at 1440 px and at 400 px with no console error and no sideways page scroll.

Skills: after `git remote -v` (origin is github.com/ariakit/visonaut) I invoked `ariakit-general-workflow`. No visonaut-specific skill is installed. I did not invoke `ariakit-general-code-style`: I wrote JavaScript only in my scratch folder, not in the repository.

Main results:

1. `sections/15-your-answers.html` is the entry point of r6. The first part has the three answers in compact form, one line for the two answers of r4, and one new example in place of the page index example:

```text
# D-SCALE-02 until then: a run in which each of 20,000 captures changed (local D1 formulas)
run approval:    5 × 20,000 +  8 = 100,008 rows in one transaction
closed summary:  8 × 20,000 + 24 = 160,024 rows in one transaction
```

The two formulas are those of the calculator in `#data-scale-run`, and the two results are in the rationale of D-SCALE-02.

2. The reading of D-SCALE-02 is stated as a reading of the record in three places: the bullet in section 15 ("The record reads the selection and the note together: the form is decided, and nothing is built until a mass change is a problem. A note can correct this reading."), the note before the three panels in section 40, and section 95.

3. "What still needs your word" has 12 items (was 11). Item 4 is now "Two writes to production D1" (the UPDATE of D-AUTH-05 and the measurement for the limit of D-SCALE-02). Item 7 is new: the row deletion of D-SCALE-03 (the wording of D14, the test of carried approvals and baseline checks, and the change of "rows stay" of D-DATA-04). The count is 12 in sections 10 and 15.

4. The order-of-work demo has 10 steps, and each of the 55 decisions is in a step (the script `round4/checker/check-order.mjs` says "55 decisions, 0 in no step, 10 steps"). Step 10 is "Later: a suite near the capture limit". It has no date.

5. Reader words: section 15 has 7,421 against 7,427 in r5 (-6). Section 40 has +147, section 60 has +30, section 65 has +27. Sections 10, 90, and 95 are shorter (-4, -3, -7).

6. `decisions.json`: one prose sentence changed (see decisionProseChanges). A script confirmed that no id, status, option list, option id, label, `recommended` flag, `settledAnswer`, `short`, `question`, or `evidence` changed against the r5 copy, except the status, settled answer, and rationale of the 3 decisions that the coordinator settled.

Not done, because it is not in my task: I did not publish the artifact. `apps/lab/audit/dist/visonaut-audit.html` and `apps/lab/public/audit/index.html` are built from the final content. I did not edit `record.json`, `terms.json`, `findings.json`, or `sections/70-design-lab.html`.

files.changes: Header comment: the first part is r4 to r6, with the sources of r6, the note that the reading of D-SCALE-02 is a reading of the coordinator, and what r6 removed to keep the length. Lead: feedback round 4, 3 answers, none adds work for the suite of today, all 55 decisions settled, 12 things still need his word; the lead links to #data-scale-run. First part: the bullet "Open, new in r5" is replaced by 3 bullets. D-SCALE-01: each run captures every screenshot, the note quoted, no partial run is designed now. D-SCALE-02: a stated limit of changed captures, the note quoted, the reading of selection and note together, and "A note can correct this reading." D-SCALE-03: the image deletion step also deletes the changed rows and decisions in D1, with step 2 of D-DATA-02 and not before, and 9.1 KB stay until then (measured, local D1). The two r4 bullets are one line (D-OPS-04: the OIDC token alone; D-DATA-02: step 1 accepts about 20,000 captures, step 2 works page by page). The page index example is replaced by the 3-line formula example for D-SCALE-02. Bar paragraph: "55 / 55 answered" (the anchor `your-answers-settled` stays). List `#your-answers-word`: 12 items; item 4 merges the UPDATE of D-AUTH-05 with the measurement on production D1 for D-SCALE-02; new item 7 for the row deletion of D-SCALE-03. Rules: rule 1 says that the 3 answers of round 4 add no row that repeats; the fact "Scale" names the 3 answers in place of the 3 questions; the fact "Other customers" points to item 10. D1 writes: new row for D-SCALE-03 in the table of one-time writes (not measured, writes no copy, the code of today writes 14 rows for each changed capture 30 days after its run closed); the calculator limits name the one-time writes of D-DATA-04 and D-SCALE-03 as left out. Differs: new row D-SCALE-01 (cost: about 26 hours of capture jobs for one run of 300,000 captures; watch: nothing now), the intro says 9 answers of round 1 and D-SCALE-01 with (4) and (6), the summary is "Ten answers, with their cost", and the D-DATA-04 row says that with D-SCALE-03 the changed rows of a closed run do not stay. Fit: "Revision r4 changed ... and added" (past tense); the row "Deletion" names D-SCALE-03. Order demo: title "Ten steps", limits "Each of the 55 settled decisions is in a step", new step 10, and step 5 says "Step 1 of D-DATA-02". Removed to hold the length (each statement is still in another place of the section or of the page): the 50-line fact and the pin cutover sentence of the D-OPS-04 bullet, the measured page sizes of the D-DATA-02 bullet, "you said on 2026-10-06 that a one-time write is acceptable" above the one-time table (rule 1 quotes it), "It runs only on your separate instruction" in the D-AUTH-05 row (item 4 has it), "The decision record says what each answer gives", "Each step starts only after what it needs", "No decision is open" in step 1, the quote “keep copied components” in step 7, and "With your answer to D-OPS-04, this is the last cutover of the pinned values" in step 9 (the row "CLI releases" has it).

Stat "Decisions 55": "All are settled with your answers. None is open." Heading "Revision r6: start with your answers". The paragraph keeps r4 and r5 as history ("Revision r5 had your answer ... found 3 new questions") and adds "Revision r6 has your feedback round 4, which settles them ... All 55 decisions are settled." The next paragraph names 12 things and no open decision.

Framing only in the checked parts; each number, table, and demo of #data-scale-run and of the D-DATA-02 part is unchanged. D-DATA-02 part (#data-inventory-outside): "the measurement and your answer, D-SCALE-02" in place of "the question that follows". #data-scale-run lead: "Settled in revision r6, with your three answers at the end of this part. This part is their research, from revision r5." and, after the estimate about the two answers that stop, "Your answers to D-SCALE-03 and D-SCALE-02 are for these two." Verdicts: D-DATA-04 "holds for images. For rows, your answer to D-SCALE-03 changes it." (was "must change for rows"); D-WORK-04 gets "Above it, your answer is the limit of D-SCALE-02." Order: item 4 gets "The row deletion of D-SCALE-03 comes with it."; item 6 names the limit of D-SCALE-02, a window for the D1 rows shorter than 30 days when many captures change, and the capture time that D-SCALE-01 leaves for later (was "parts or a limit ..., an end for the D1 rows, and an answer to the capture time"). Note before the panels: "Your three answers of round 4 follow. For D-SCALE-02 the record reads your selection and your note together: the form is decided, and nothing is built now." (was "Three proposed questions follow, and none is settled"). D-DATA-04 part: one sentence, "Revision r6: with your answer to D-SCALE-03, the changed rows and the decisions of a closed run do not stay after step 2 of D-DATA-02." Table "Stored data with no deleter": one new row, "Changed rows and decisions of closed runs, in D1" (9.1 KB for each changed capture, measured on a local D1; 16 to 25 MB each month for the suite of today, estimate; the code writes 2 copies 30 days after a run closed and no step deletes them; D-SCALE-03 deletes them later). The section lead needed no change.

One sentence in the D-WORK-04 part, after "so the decision is settled": "The answer holds to some thousands of changes in one run: above that, your answer to D-SCALE-02 is a stated limit of changes, when a mass change is a problem."

One sentence at the end of the paragraph "Settled in revision r3: show the stored name": "With your answer to D-SCALE-03, a closed run older than the 30-day window keeps no decision for one variant, so the page names no reviewer there."
"All 55 are settled." in place of "52 are settled, and 3 are open."

First paragraph: all 55 decisions are settled, so the record needs no answer; the maintainer can still change an answer or write a note, for example to correct the reading of the note on D-SCALE-02; the prompt and the merge are as before. The second paragraph is unchanged: implementation and GitHub publication are out of scope until he authorizes them separately.

One sentence in the consequences of the option `parts-for-any-count` of D-SCALE-02, which the maintainer did not select (see decisionProseChanges). `pnpm exec oxfmt apps/lab/audit/content` also changed the line layout of this file after the coordinator script wrote it with JSON.stringify: the data is the same (checked field by field against the r5 copy).

Scratch folder: the edit scripts (replace-holds.mjs, edit-15-b.mjs to edit-15-g.mjs, edit-10-90-95.mjs, edit-40.mjs, edit-40-b.mjs, edit-40-c.mjs, edit-final.mjs, edit-decisions.mjs), the checks (words.mjs, words-parts.mjs, verify-json.mjs, verify-decisions-strict.mjs, look.mjs, saved.mjs), and the pictures in shots/ (22 places at 1440 px and at 400 px, the open table of answers that differ, and step 10 of the order demo).

decisionProseChanges: D-SCALE-02, option `parts-for-any-count` (not selected), field `consequences`. Before: "So it also needs an answer to D-SCALE-03 and a capacity stop above 2 GiB." After: "So it also needs your answer to D-SCALE-03 and a capacity stop above 2 GiB." Reason: the sentence said that D-SCALE-03 has no answer, and r6 settled it. No other prose in decisions.json names a D-SCALE decision as open or proposed. I did not change the settled answer of D-DATA-04 ("Inventories and bookkeeping rows stay"): the limits forbid it, and the sections now say that D-SCALE-03 changes it for the changed rows and decisions of a closed run.
needsYourWord: Section 40 is 147 reader words longer than in r5 (14,057 against 13,910). The framing sentences are about 110 of them, and the new row in the table "Stored data with no deleter" is about 38. If the row is not wanted, remove the one `<tr>` "Changed rows and decisions of closed runs, in D1".

To keep section 15 not longer than its r5 copy (7,421 against 7,427 words), I removed old sentences that another place of the section or of the page also has. The list is in the entry for the file. The largest are the detail of the two r4 bullets and the page index example (they are in #state-checks-pins and #data-inventory-pages). Say if one must come back: the section then needs a cut in another place.

The change in decisions.json is in an option of D-SCALE-02 itself, not in another decision. The task named "OTHER decisions". Revert it if an option text of a D-SCALE decision must stay as the maintainer saw it: change "your answer" back to "an answer" in the option `parts-for-any-count`.

`sections/70-design-lab.html` differs from its r5 copy (+102 reader words: "round 2 is built ..." and a paragraph "Known limits"). Another agent changed it while I worked. I did not edit it. My `oxfmt` runs on `apps/lab/audit/content` could have formatted it. I found no statement in it about the count or the state of the audit decisions that r6 makes false. I did not check its lab facts.

The D-SCALE-01 row in "Where your answer differs" has "Watch: Nothing now: your note defers it." I left out the limit of 5 macOS jobs (116,000 to 178,000 captures) to hold the length, because the note says "No need to think about this now." The limit is in the panel and in the table of #data-scale-run.
doubts: D14 and D-SCALE-03. The rationale of D-SCALE-03 says two things: the answer "changes ... the earlier decision D14, which forbids a row deletion", and "the wording of D14" is a check that comes first. The option text says that D14 forbids a row deletion "for retired data". Item 7 of the list says "D14 also forbids a row deletion: its wording needs a check." I did not add D14 to the list of changed earlier decisions in item 9 (the contract), because the record does not say if D14 covers these rows.

The one-time write of D-SCALE-03. The rationale says that the deletion "replaces the 14 rows that the code of today writes for each changed capture after 30 days". The option text says "A deletion in place of the 2 copies is not measured." The 14 rows are the closed summary and the release together, and I do not know if the release part stays. So the row in section 15 says only: "Not measured. It writes no copy." and, as a measured fact, that the code of today writes 14 rows for each changed capture 30 days after its run closed.

The table "Where your answer differs" still has the scope of r5: answers of round 1, and now D-SCALE-01. With the flags of today, D-RES-06 (keep-queue, no recommended option) is also an answer where the record recommends no option, and it has no row. I did not add it, because it is not part of this round.

Section 65: "so the page names no reviewer there" follows from the rationale of D-SCALE-03 ("the name of the reviewer of a single variant is lost"). I did not check in the code which view of a closed run shows the name.

Section 40, order item 6: "a window for the D1 rows that is shorter than 30 days when many captures change" comes from the option text of D-SCALE-03 ("With 1% of 300,000 in each run it is not enough, and the window for rows must then be shorter than 30 days"). It replaces "an end for the D1 rows", because the deletion itself is now in item 4.

The lead of section 15 says "None adds work for the suite of today." This is my summary of the three settled answers (no design for partial runs now; nothing built until a mass change is a problem; with step 2 of D-DATA-02 and not before). The record does not have this sentence in these words.

The label of step 10, "Later: a suite near the capture limit", is the condition of step 2 of D-DATA-02 and of D-SCALE-03. D-SCALE-02 has another condition (a mass change that is a problem), which the description of the step states.
The bar paragraph is now "The bar at the top says “55 / 55 answered”, and the prompt lists no decision." It no longer says "until you change an answer". Section 95 says that.

`check.mjs` has 29 cases for each output (116 pass lines). The editor of r4 reported that it skips cases when no decision is open. I did not change the tool. I ran one more case by hand (saved.mjs): a browser with the r5 baseline and the three answers of round 4 shows "55 / 55 answered", the three panels as Answered with the selections and notes of the record, and a prompt with no decision.
